instruction: At my job, we manage the tasks on todoist. But I am changing job soon, so for each task that is assigned to me and is incomplete yet, I have asked who can take it from me. See the discussion in comments and reassign based on it. Then, leave a comment there, "Greatly appreciate it <person_first_name>!". Here <person_first_name> is the first name of the person who is reassigned the task. If no one has agreed to take the task, leave it as is.
notes: Representative instance: the work project holds three incomplete tasks assigned to the supervisor; for task-1 and task-2 a collaborator agreed in the comments (volunteer-a, volunteer-b), for task-3 nobody did, so it is left untouched (only its comments must be read). The actual number of tasks and the volunteers are discovered at runtime via show_tasks (filtered by assignee_email and is_completed=false) and show_task_comments; the static facts volunteer-for / no-volunteer / person-email / thank-you-text encode the world and are gated by the knowledge predicates (tasks-listed, comments-read). Reassignment must precede the thank-you comment (post_task_comment requires reassigned). supervisor.complete_task takes the task records as non-API parameters with pairwise distinctness so its precondition equals the goal; it is the only action that sets task-completed and all other actions require (not (task-completed)). supervisor.show_profile is included to obtain the supervisor's email used as the assignee_email filter (also usable as the todoist username).

plan: (supervisor-complete-task task-3 task-4 task-5 volunteer-3 volunteer-4 thanks-volunteer-3 thanks-volunteer-4)
